One point per municipality of Mexico (INEGI 2019), all or by state

Source: R/municipalities.R
municipalities.Rd

The table comes with the package (2,465 municipalities), so no download is needed; it is ready for download_nasa_power_data() with id_col = "CVEGEO".

Usage

municipalities(cve_edo = NULL, point = c("inside", "centroid"))

Arguments

cve_edo

State code(s) ("31", 31 or c("14", "31")). NULL returns the 2,465 municipalities of the country.

point

"inside" (default) uses a point that is always inside the municipality (its representative point); "centroid" uses the geometric centroid, which falls outside 67 curved or fragmented municipalities (column centroid_inside).

Value

A data frame with CVEGEO, CVE_ENT, state, CVE_MUN, municipality, latitude, longitude (WGS84), centroid_lat, centroid_lon, centroid_inside and area_km2.

Examples

yuc <- municipalities("31")        # the 106 municipalities of Yucatán
head(yuc[, c("CVEGEO", "municipality", "latitude", "longitude")])
#>   CVEGEO municipality latitude longitude
#> 1  31001        Abalá 20.65865 -89.65313
#> 2  31002      Acanceh 20.82194 -89.46736
#> 3  31003         Akil 20.25901 -89.34417
#> 4  31004         Baca 21.13258 -89.39758
#> 5  31005       Bokobá 20.99497 -89.17299
#> 6  31006     Buctzotz 21.21079 -88.65766
nrow(municipalities())             # all the country
#> [1] 2465
